name: Pivot Token Representation
definition: A compact encoding for an active voxel consisting of a pivot point p on the local surface patch and a binary inside/outside orientation cue s, used to approximate the surface geometry by an ideal plane under Assumption 1 (Local Planarity).
summary: Pivot Token Representation is a compact voxelization method encoding active voxels with a single pivot point and orientation sign to reduce memory usage while enabling efficient multi-resolution structures.
